planes.P0_before_PBS: Input reference immediately before PBS; ax/ay live only here.
planes.A0: Immediately after PBS A output, before all A-section optics.
planes.B0: Immediately after PBS B output, before all B-section optics.
planes.A1: Immediately before NPBS1 input A, after all A-section optics.
planes.B1: Immediately before NPBS1 input B, after all B-section optics.
planes.C0: Immediately after NPBS1 output C, before all C-section optics.
planes.D0: Immediately after NPBS1 output D, before all D-section optics.
planes.C1: Immediately before NPBS2 input C, after all C-section optics.
planes.D1: Immediately before NPBS2 input D, after all D-section optics.
planes.E0: Immediately after NPBS2 output E, before detector optics/coupling.
planes.F0: Immediately after NPBS2 output F, before detector optics/coupling.
planes.fiber: After projection into the monitored fiber mode; never called arm transmission.
planes.camera_z1_z2: Two recorded longitudinal camera planes, referenced to E0/F0.

assumptions: H/V bases must be verified at each reflection/measurement plane; H maps to s1=-1 in this repository.
Power-only PBS/NPBS reduction assumes diagonal H/V coefficients. Check output polarization; use a full measured matrix if this fails.
Each arm Jones matrix includes all amplitude transmission between its two named planes.
Single-mode Jones reconstruction requires sufficiently polarized light; partial polarization is not normalized away.
Unknown inter-port/global arm phases remain explicit nuisance parameters; absolute-phase agreement is conditional until independently constrained.
